_comment: RViT+ V13 configuration: a FROZEN self-supervised PREDICTIVE-CODING encoder repurposed for RL by an ENERGY-MODULATION stream. CONV-FREE, TWO PHASES. PHASE 1 (pretrain_pc.py, self-supervised): PART A = T1 (Q=W_q*X, K=W_k*H1, V=W_v*H2, skip=X) -> Z1 -> LSTM1 -> H1 -> LSTM2 -> H2; trained by JEPA predictive coding (predictor(proj2(H2_t)) ~ proj1(H1_(t+1)), VICReg var+cov anti-collapse) -> a quantified surprise. PHASE 2 (train_rl.py --pc-checkpoint): FREEZE PART A + patch_embed; add PART B = LSTM3 (H3<-LSTM3(H2)) + T2 (Q=W_q'*H2, K=W_k'*H3, V=W_v'*H3, skip=H2) -> Z_energy; inject Z_energy in place of H2 as T1's V source; the modulated Z1 -> actor+critic. Only PART B + heads train (PAC + QR-DQN + PER). THE TEST: can a frozen self-supervised recurrent transformer+LSTM be repurposed for a different (RL) task purely by energy-modulating its dynamical system? d_latent = the predictive-coding projection width. Priority: CLI arg > this config > script default.

run._note_init_mode: fresh = random init (checkpoint_path ignored); warm_start = partial load; resume = strict load. The SOFT-attention v12 is a NEW mechanism (different grad flow from the failed sampled run) — start FRESH so the old sampled checkpoint is not loaded. (Set to resume ONLY after a soft checkpoint exists, to continue; running fresh re-trains from scratch AND overwrites the saved checkpoint.)
run._note_checkpoint_location: checkpoint_dir points OUTSIDE the repo (~/rvit_plus_checkpoints/v13) on purpose: the AttentionManuscript repo is a Google Drive sync root and Drive was observed rewriting checkpoints mid-session, which can corrupt a run. Keep live checkpoints in a non-synced home dir.
run._note_pc_checkpoint: PHASE 1 predictive-coding pretrained model (from pretrain_pc.py). train_rl.py loads it, FREEZES PART A (the self-supervised encoder + patch_embed), and trains ONLY the energy stream (PART B) + heads. THE v13 experiment. null = train the whole model from scratch (not the frozen-encoder test).

environment._comment: ChangeDetectionEnv parameters — matched to the v3/HRA defaults for apples-to-apples comparison.

model._comment: Conv-free patch + cross-attention-over-memory block (8 heads) + 2 stacked per-token LSTMs + 1D-conv actor/critic heads.
model._note_patch: patch_size must divide the 50x50 image: {1,2,5,10,25,50}. patch_size=5 → 10x10 grid = 100 tokens (each 25x25 Gabor quadrant = a 5x5 patch block).
model._note_patch_hidden: The raw flattened patch is small (patch_dim = C*p*p = 3*5*5 = 75). A per-patch MLP (Linear→GELU→Linear→LayerNorm) of hidden width patch_hidden expands it up to d_model. Default 128 = d_model.
model._note_d_latent: Predictive-coding (JEPA) projection width: H1/H2 are projected to d_latent and the predictor operates there. Default = d_model.
model._note_d_model: d_model = transformer/token width; d_mem = LSTM hidden = recurrent-state width the heads read. MUST be equal (128): memory (H1,H2) is concatenated into the d_model token stream as cross-attention keys/values. LSTM1 ingests the d_model attention output Z; later LSTMs ingest the previous d_mem hidden.
model._note_tx: VQ codebook attention, tx_heads heads (default 1 = a SINGLE codebook; >1 = a product/multi-head codebook, each head with its own blend/slot). Q=W_q*X, K=W_k*H2, V=codebook; DEFAULT weights = softmax(QK'/sqrt(d)/tau) (soft blend over slots); Z=W_o*(weights @ codebook)+FFN, NO X-residual. Shared positional embedding added to queries and keys.
model._note_n_lstm: Must be 1 — the ONLY recurrent state is the key-memory H2 (updated by LSTM from X+Z, carried (B,n_tokens,d_mem) across frames). The VALUE codebook is now a STATIC learnable table (nn.Parameter, n_tokens slots), addressed by the evolving keys — NOT recurrent. The heads read the transformer output Z (rec=[Z]). Knobs (model defaults, not wired into train_rl): vq_mode='soft' (DEFAULT — plain soft softmax blend, fully differentiable, no sampling; this is the current run) | 'sample' (multinomial, straight-through) | 'argmax' (deterministic, straight-through; the failed sampled run used these hard modes), vq_temperature=1.0 (lower=sharper).
model._note_head: Actor & critic decoders are 1D-CONV, BOTH reading the transformer output Z arranged as (B, d_model channels, n_tokens length), run through n_conv_layers stride-2 Conv1d layers (kernel conv_kernel, conv_channels each) over the TOKEN axis, then flatten + Linear. PRESERVES the spatial token layout. No CLS, no action-as-input encoding. Final Linear small-init'd; actor init_action_bias on its bias. With n_tokens=100/3 stride-2 layers the token axis is 100→50→25→13.
model._note_rl_heads: Actor logits (B,n_actions) + distributional critic Q (B,n_actions,n_quantiles), each from H2 via a SEPARATE Conv1d-over-tokens trunk → flatten → Linear. init_action_bias = [wait_bias, press_bias]; [0.0,-1.5] gives initial P(press)≈0.18.

ppo._comment: PAC actor loss (MPO E-step + BC) + distributional QR-DQN critic + prioritized episode replay. RL ONLY — no recon, no PC, no pretrain.
ppo._note_pac_actor: PAC (Springenberg, Abdolmaleki et al., DeepMind 2024) REPLACES PPO's clipped surrogate. Discrete MPO E-step is closed-form: q(a|s) = softmax_a[ log π_old(a|s) + Q̄(s,a)/η ]; M-step + BC blend gives L_actor = (1−α)·[−Σ_a q(a|s)·log π_θ(a|s)] + α·[−log π_θ(a_t|s)]. η = mpo_temperature, α = bc_alpha.
ppo._note_target_network: PAC target network θ' (Springenberg et al. 2024, §3.2): the critic's distributional TD target AND the MPO E-step reference policy π_θ' BOTH come from a periodically hard-copied, time-lagged copy of θ. target_update_period = hard-copy θ→θ' every N optimizer steps; 0 disables (online bootstrap). The main stabilizer for the bootstrapped actor-critic; was missing in the original implementation.
ppo._note_burn_in: Burn-in / wait-pretrain (v3's recon_pretrain_iters, restored 2026-06-06). For the first burn_in_iters iterations the agent is FORCED to wait (action=0) so episodes run full-length, and only the critic is trained with the actor FROZEN at init — warming up the value function and recurrent representation on clean full trajectories before the policy acts. v5 has no decoder/recon (and no contrastive), so the critic/representation warm up alone. 0 disables.
ppo._note_per: Prioritized episode replay (Schaul et al. 2016, episode-level). Fresh on-policy episodes are augmented with per_n_replay replay episodes sampled ∝ priority^per_alpha (priority = mean per-step quantile-Huber error, clipped at per_priority_clip×median). IS weights (1/(N·p))^β with β annealed per_beta_start→per_beta_end over the run. per_n_replay=0 disables replay.
